data.exact_reserve_text: An unfavourable run-off deviation (prior accident years' increase) of GBP 4.7m (2016: favorable run-off deviation of GBP 2.5m) was experienced during the year, wholly in respect of reserve movements on the 2015 year of account and prior Whole Account Quota Share contract with Syndicate 2003.
data.standardized_narrative: Syndicate 6111 experienced a GBP 4.7 million strengthening in prior year reserves, representing an unfavourable run-off deviation of 2.23% against opening gross claims outstanding. This movement was primarily attributed to reserve adjustments on the 2015 year of account and prior Whole Account Quota Share contract with Syndicate 2003. No specific lines of business were identified as being disproportionately affected by this development.
